newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Bolger says government to have 20 ministers.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Bolger says government to have 20 ministers.

text.p: Prime Minister Jim Bolger said on Wednesday the new government would have 20 ministers inside cabinet and six outside.

New Zealand First leader Winston Peters said earlier that a coalition deal signed with the caretaker conservative National Party gave NZ First an initial five ministers in cabinet. This would rise to eight ministers beginning October 1, 1998.
Prime Minister Jim Bolger confirmed that Peters, in his new role as Treasurer, would be senior to Finance Minister Bill Birch in making economic decisions.
